item.title: What’s inside the Kmart site housing proposals?
item.description: Minneapolis seeks public feedback on competing affordable housing proposals from Aeon and Trellis for the first phase of redevelopment at the former Kmart site.

item.title: Interview: Dan Ruehl, senior acquisitions manager, Enclave Cos.
item.description: Dan Ruehl, senior acquisitions manager at Enclave Cos., talks about why Enclave is jumping into the investment game, what the company is looking for in new properties, as well as his own career.

item.title: Nearly all used EV prices drop after tax credit ends
item.description: Used Tesla and Porsche Taycan prices climbed after the federal EV tax credit ended, while most other used electric vehicle prices fell, study finds.

item.title: Homes, cars feel unaffordable for middle-class, poll finds
item.description: A Washington Post-ABC News-Ipsos poll finds most Americans say health care, new cars and homes are unaffordable despite easing inflation.

item.title: Restaurants emerge as bright spot for U.S. job growth
item.description: U.S. restaurant jobs rose in 2025 as consumers cut big purchases but splurged on dining, coffee and desserts, boosting chains like Chili’s and Dutch Bros.

item.title: States reconsider data center tax incentives
item.description: States move to repeal data center tax incentives as lawmakers cite rising electricity costs, environmental concerns and billions in lost revenue.

item.title: Best at Work Insights: The choice we’re making about AI
item.description: AI can save time but U.S. workers report mixed results due to lack of training and connection loss. Effective AI aligns with workflows and supports human judgment.

item.title: Construction spending lifted by rebound in single-family homebuilding
item.description: U.S. construction spending increased in December, lifted by a rebound in single-family homebuilding as well as ongoing strength in home renovations.

item.title: Q&A: Hendrickson gears up for new CEO role with Adolfson & Peterson
item.description: Adolfson & Peterson names Brad Hendrickson CEO as Jeff Hansen retires, capping record growth and $1.5B in revenue for the 80-year-old firm.

item.title: Where does City Center go from here?
item.description: The City Center office tower in downtown Minneapolis prepares for sale and potential redevelopment.
